stem: At Larkspur Group, retail and wholesale each have a project with its own team permissions. The shared `pricing` workspace must be usable by both teams through permissions. What is the correct approach?

choices.text: Add the `pricing` workspace to both projects at the same time
Scope a variable set to both projects to make the `pricing` workspace join each
Keep `pricing` in one project and grant the other team access on the workspace itself
Move `pricing` into the Default Project and rely on that project's permissions

rationale: Every workspace belongs to exactly one project, and permissions can be set at project and workspace scope, so the second team can be granted access directly on the workspace. Placing a workspace in two projects is not possible. A variable set scoped to a project applies variables to the workspaces already in it and does not change which project a workspace belongs to. The Default Project is just the project where workspaces start; each project has a separate permissions set, so it does not give every team access automatically.
